caption: The drawing depicts a single long dress in a rich green color occupying most of the composition, set against a blank, beige background. The dress is floor-length with a full, voluminous skirt, and it features long sleeves that are fitted at the wrists. The bodice of the dress is tailored and has a high neckline with a small, light-colored collar detail. Decorative trim lines the yoke across the chest and shoulders as well as the cuffs, and a row of buttons runs down the front of the bodice. There is no visible head, hands, or feet, and the dress appears to float slightly above the ground. The shading on the dress suggests folds and movement in the fabric, while the overall style is characterized by simple, clean lines and a softly rendered appearance.
title: Wedding Dress
